name: Tenaron Stormgrip
summary: Tenaron Stormgrip is a night elf guide high within Aldrassil, the central tree of Shadowglen. He teaches young kaldorei the recent history of their people while asking them to gather moonwell water.

sections.title: Watcher of Aldrassil
sections.body: Perched upon the winding wooden platforms of Aldrassil, Tenaron Stormgrip stands as an early mentor to young night elves stepping forth from the boughs of Shadowglen. From his vantage point, he monitors the health of the local woods and the vital moonwells that sustain them. His role is to instruct novices in understanding their profound spiritual connection to the World Tree.

sections.title: Crown of the Earth
sections.body: Tenaron begins the journey known as Crown of the Earth. He sends initiates to gather a phial of water from the moonwell north of Aldrassil, teaching them what followed the Battle of Mount Hyjal. The journey continues through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.

faq.answer: Tenaron Stormgrip stands atop the wooden ramp structures of Aldrassil, the massive central tree at the heart of Shadowglen in Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is Tenaron Stormgrip's role in Shadowglen?
faq.answer: He guides young night elves, introducing the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal through the Crown of the Earth journey.

faq.q: What is the Crown of the Earth quest?
faq.answer: Tenaron asks initiates to gather moonwell water in a phial and return it to him. The journey teaches the recent history of the night elves and continues across Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why is Tenaron concerned about Teldrassil's waters?
faq.answer: The moonwells are essential vessels of Elune's grace and natural purity. Because Teldrassil is young and lacks the full blessing of the Aspects, caretakers like Tenaron closely monitor every water source for signs of corruption or taint.

faq.q: Does Tenaron send adventurers beyond Shadowglen?
faq.answer: Yes. Once an initiate demonstrates reverence and competence in handling the sacred waters, Tenaron directs them outward into greater Teldrassil, sending them down to Dolanaar to continue serving the kaldorei.

faq.q: Is Tenaron a druid or a priest?
faq.answer: His class is not established by the sources. He teaches recent night elf history and explains the significance of moonwells.

angles.text: For young night elves, Tenaron Stormgrip provides one of the very first introductions to the communal and spiritual duties required to keep Teldrassil alive and pure.
Tenaron's tasks highlight the druidic stewardship needed to monitor Teldrassil's unprecedented growth and guard against subtle corruption.
